title: dotfiles third-party apt repositories
description: Editor hint only; .bin/validate-manifest.py is authoritative. Keys are repo ids referenced by packages.json apt entries.

key_url.description: Signing-key URL, fetched before APT source mutation.

repo.description: APT source line; @ARCH@/@RELEASE@ are expanded by repos.yml.

key_sha256.description: Optional pinned checksum for the downloaded signing key.

key_fingerprint.description: Expected OpenPGP fingerprint; key rotation requires a match before replacing the keyring.
